title: 签租约前必问的英语
summary: 签字之前把押金、交租日期、水电、申请费问清楚，免得住进去才后悔。这篇教你签约前的关键英语。

phrases.en: Are utilities included in the rent?
Can I get a copy of the lease?

dialogue.speaker: Renter
dialogue.en: I'm ready to sign. Is the security deposit refundable?
dialogue.zh: 我准备签了。押金能退吗？

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.en: Yes, as long as there's no damage.

dialogue.speaker: Renter
dialogue.en: When is the rent due each month?

dialogue.speaker: Landlord
dialogue.en: On the first. There's a late fee after the fifth.
dialogue.zh: 1 号交，5 号之后有滞纳金。

dialogue.speaker: Renter
dialogue.en: Okay. Can I get a copy of the lease?
dialogue.zh: 好的。能给我一份租约复印件吗？

seoTitle: 签租约英语怎么说？签约前必问
seoDescription: 在美国签租房合同，押金退不退、几号交租、水电包不包怎么问？本文教你签约前的关键英语和完整对话。
